Sara (CS): Heads-up: ACME says codegen broke immediately after the rw-code-1 rollout yesterday. Their CI started failing because generated JS has syntax errors and omitted helper functions. They provided a repro and example.

ACME (customer): "We POST to /v1/generate to create a NodeJS function using our `acme-sdk`. Since the deploy the output sometimes has a stray trailing comma and misses helper `formatUser`. This used to work. Repro: 
1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-code-1","prompt":"Generate nodejs function using `acme-sdk` to createUser`"}'
2) Save reply as file.js and run `node file.js`

Returned snippet:
```
const {acme} = require('acme-sdk')

async function createUser(data,) {
  const res = await acme.create(data)
  return res
}
```
Node error: SyntaxError: Unexpected token ')'

Mike (Support): I reproduced with a test key and got the exact trailing comma in multiple calls. Also saw missing `formatUser`. Seems triggered when the prompt contains backticks around the SDK name. Logging outputs to the ACME ticket.

deploy-bot: rollout rw-code-1 v2026-06-24 -> 100% at 2026-06-24T03:12:11Z

Lina (Eng Runtime): Confirmed kernel switch to tokenizer-batching at that timestamp.

Devon (Product): I merged an import-dedupe template change (PR-529) recently; I thought it was canary-only. Opening revert PR now.

Hao (ML Eng): Quick eval diff between v2026-06-10 and v2026-06-24: helper inclusion drops from ~80% -> ~30% on affected prompts; occasional punctuation tokenization leads to lingering commas. Hypothesis: template dedupe + new tokenizer normalization interact and strip helper stubs incorrectly.

Sara (CS): Customer impact is CI failures across several repos. They want rollback or a per-account opt-out for template changes.

Lina (Eng Runtime): Short-term mitigation: we can honor header `x-rw-postproc: legacy` to skip the new dedupe postproc on codegen routes. Can Support try this and share with ACME?

Mike (Support): Tested header with ACME sample: with `x-rw-postproc: legacy` the generated file runs under node (trailing comma gone, helper present). Sending instructions to ACME and recommending they add the header until we resolve.

ACME (customer): Thanks. Please provide a config flag so future template tweaks don't silently break us.

Devon (Product): Approve a short global rollback for rw-code-1 to v2026-06-10 for 1 hour while we push a fix. Lina please roll back and monitor. We'll post to status.

Lina (Eng Runtime): Rollback initiated to v2026-06-10. ETA ~8m. Will keep canary at 0%.

deploy-bot: rollback rw-code-1 to v2026-06-10 initiated at 2026-06-24T05:03:02Z

Hao (ML Eng): After rollback I ran the prompt 30x: helper restored to ~82% and comma issue disappeared. I'll add a regression test covering backtick-quoted identifiers + import/helper retention and produce token boundary diffs for infra.

Sara (CS): Escalation opened ESC-2026-1302 assigned to Eng Runtime + ML. Please keep ACME in the loop; they want ETA for safe redeploy.

Devon (Product): Next steps: revert PR-529, rework dedupe to be tokenizer-robust (use fuzzy matching), staged canary after tests.

Hao (ML Eng): Action items: add regression test to eval suite, attach tokenization diffs and sample top-k outputs, propose postproc patch.

Lina (Eng Runtime): Action items: monitor rollback, add per-customer feature flag for postproc opt-out, hold redeploy until ML sign-off.

Mike (Support): Action items: keep ACME posted, confirm CI green, provide temporary client sample with legacy header.

Sara (CS): Summary owners: Devon (product) - revert & redeploy plan; Hao (ML) - reg tests & diffs; Lina (runtime) - rollback & flag; Mike (support) - customer comms. Closing escalation after ACME confirms CI passes.

Sara (CS): tagging @Hao @Lina @Devon @Mike @deploy-bot. Will update ESC-2026-1302 with artifacts and logs.
